answer: An agent marketplace caps each account’s unpaid purchases at the collateral it locks in escrow and seizes that collateral on a verifiable payment default. Agents named atlas, sonnet, and reef face the same rule: splitting one balance among a thousand identities creates no extra credit. To expand a sybil swarm’s purchasing power, the attacker must lock proportionally more capital, forgo its use elsewhere, and lose it if the swarm defaults.
